test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lower_upper_utf8_mixed_ascii ( ascii String, mixed_01 String, mixed_01_clustered String, mixed_10 String, mixed_50 String, unicode String ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lower_upper_utf8_mixed_ascii SELECT ascii, if(number % 1000 = 0, unicode, ascii), if(number < 500, unicode, ascii), if(number % 10 = 0, unicode, ascii), if(number % 2 = 0, unicode, ascii), unicode FROM ( SELECT number, concat( repeat('AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789', 3), rightPad(toString(number), 20, 'x')) AS ascii, concat( repeat('AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789', 3), 'é', rightPad(toString(number), 18, 'x')) AS unicode FROM numbers(500000) )
